description: radical trachelectomy for an HPV-independent gastric-type adenocarcinoma involving the left parametrium with lymphovascular invasion, radial margin involved, one pelvic macrometastasis with extranodal extension, pT2b pN1a
report:
Cervix, radical trachelectomy

Received in formalin is a radical trachelectomy specimen. There is an endophytic, infiltrative tumour in the right inferior (posterior) quadrant measuring 19 x 15 mm. Representative sections are taken in 20 blocks.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical trachelectomy
- Tumour site: Right inferior (posterior) quadrant (6 to 9 o'clock)
- Tumour size: 19 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 19 x 15 x 11 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma, HPV-independent, gastric type
- p16 immunohistochemistry: Negative
- Depth of stromal invasion: Greater than 5 mm (deepest 11 mm)
- Depth of stromal invasion (proportion): Deep one-third
- Horizontal extent of stromal invasion: Not applicable
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Left parametrium
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the cervix show involvement by HPV-independent adenocarcinoma, gastric type, in the right inferior (posterior) quadrant. Infiltrating glands are lined by columnar cells with abundant clear to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Involved by invasive adenocarcinoma
  - Endocervical / lower uterine segment margin: 12 mm
  - Vaginal cuff margin: 9 mm
  - Radial (circumferential) margin: Involved, left parametrium

Lymph nodes
- Pelvic lymph nodes: 16 examined (2 sentinel); 1 involved
  - Macrometastasis (more than 2 mm): 1 node
  - Site(s) with positive lymph nodes: Left external iliac
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 6 mm
  - Extranodal extension: Present

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2b pN1a

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: None identified

CERVIX, radical trachelectomy:
- ADENOCARCINOMA, HPV-independent, gastric type, involving the left parametrium
- Radial margin involved by invasive adenocarcinoma
- 1 of 16 pelvic lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present
- pT2b pN1a (AJCC 9th edition).
